findings.evidence: A third construction on the rate-limit concept. The shipped fr corpus writes it as «limite de débit» (9 values, e.g. ui.chat.error_block.rate_limit.before) and «{host} limité en débit» (ui.code_review.host.cooling). Noun-first «Débit audio limité» reads first as an audio-bitrate cap in a card whose subject is audio. Not misleading — the sentence below («La génération audio est très sollicitée en ce moment.») names the condition — and the class stays distinct from the other five.
findings.suggested: «Audio limité en débit» (21 cells, keeps the corpus construction and its own word «débit»), or keep as is and let the sentence below disambiguate.
